scope: Semantic review of the 50 atlas cards, twelve mission definitions and capstone boundary, using current official source sections and actual game controls. This does not constitute vendor endorsement, human learning validation or live execution of every suggested prompt.

atlas.title: Projects and local folders
atlas.prerequisites: Choose the intended project or directory; project types have different context behavior.
atlas.judgment: Local folders and uploaded ChatGPT project context are distinct; surface caveat prevents folder-access inference.

atlas.title: One task, one outcome
atlas.prerequisites: New-task controls and source access depend on the selected client and project.
atlas.judgment: Focused deliverables are suggested practice, not an automatic isolation guarantee.
atlas.exampleClassification: Suggested practice prompt, not a reproduced live execution

atlas.title: Pinning and archiving
atlas.prerequisites: Use a supported sidebar and account. Confirm the specific task before reorganizing it.
atlas.judgment: Documentation explicitly separates sidebar placement from context/access and permits archive restoration.
atlas.exampleClassification: Suggested practice prompt, not a reproduced live execution

atlas.title: Find previous work
atlas.prerequisites: Search matching and shortcut assignments depend on the app version.

atlas.title: Commands and shortcuts

atlas.title: Activity and notifications

atlas.title: Interactive explanations

atlas.judgment: Installation definition supports completed-history fork; related protocol documents thread/fork. Checkout choice is independent and explicitly conditional.
atlas.exampleClassification: Suggested practice prompt, not a reproduced live execution

capstone.judgment: Cedar is a fictional practice assignment with independently checked two-period outputs. Structured evidence earns the score; free prose meaning is explicitly not machine-graded. First submission and hint use persist. No certification, live automation, professional competence or human outcome claim.

supplementaryGrounding.section: Web search treats retrieved results as untrusted

limits: Two installation cards rely on exposed definitions, not newly executed task creation/fork/pinning.
Account, rollout, client and prerequisites remain part of each capability claim.
Durations in lesson metadata are estimates, not measured human completion times.
No numerical model benchmark, revenue outcome, novice learning lift or universal hardware support is asserted.
